description.en: Specifies how the input document is provided. Set this to `true` if you provide the document content as a base64-encoded string in the `Body` parameter. Set this to `false` if you provide the document's URL in the `Content` parameter.
The base64-encoded content of the image file. Use this parameter when `BinaryToText` is set to `true`.
The URL of the image or PDF file.
The model ID. You can find the model ID on the Model List page.

description.zh: 模型对应的版本号，如果不传入版本号表示默认用模型最新生效的版本。
description.en: The version of the model. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the latest active version of the model by default.
